title: The Seven Angels and the Seven Last Plagues
description: John sees a sign in heaven where seven angels receive the seven last plagues to complete God's wrath. Those who have overcome the beast stand by a sea of glass mixed with fire and sing the song of Moses and the Lamb. Then the temple in heaven is opened, and the angels come out dressed in shining linen. One of the four living creatures gives them golden bowls filled with God's wrath, and the temple fills with smoke so that no one can enter until the plagues are completed.
